chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
About a man who performs salat (prayer) while letting the two sides of his garment hang loose, he said: “There is no issue with it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it; it is permissible
key_terms.يُرْسِلُ: he lets hang loose or releases

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray while the sides of one’s garment are left hanging loose?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning attire during salat (prayer). Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that there is no problem with a man praying while the sides of his garment hang loose, indicating the permissibility of this manner of dress in prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.800 - Abdullah ibn Bukayr asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

about a man praying while letting the sides of his garment hang loose.
Imam (as) said: "There is no issue with it”.
